name: @teactjs/ui
description: Telegram UI components for Teact — Message, Button, InlineKeyboard, Photo, and more

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
